mutantControl.verdict: Both controls had to fail, and both did under both engines, so the properties are not vacuous.

observations: Seed success is reached in only about 25% of full-handler runs. The donor's pair.sync, synced donation or dust pair.mint (409 successful dust mints) poisons the empty pair, and every exitAndSeed after that reverts PairNotEmpty. abort stayed live in every case. This is the CODE-001 DoS, not a new finding.

No exitAndSeed call that satisfied the preconditions ever reverted (P7c held on 65 + 127 checked calls in forge, plus the Medusa campaign). No spurious-revert or brick path was found beyond pair poisoning and stale floors (ECON-002).

Mocks: Balancer is MockV3ExitRouter (pro-rata, burns via the router allowance) with constant-product swaps simulated by the handler; UniV2 is the repo's faithful-maths pair/router. Real-network behaviour is covered by the fork suites in test/run22/*.fork.t.sol, not here.
honesty: PASS means no counterexample was found within forge 256 runs x 50 depth per campaign and Medusa ~300k calls / 5 min on 4 workers. That is absence of evidence, not proof. P2/P3/P6 are candidates for Halmos if a proof is wanted (single call, few divisions).
